nativeRuns.projection: Raw PIDs, tokens, paths, child command lines and environment records are omitted. Recorded equality, liveness, marker-state and cleanup observations are retained.

ordinaryQa.branchObservation: The new vanished-marker EPERM read branch returns silently. None of the six ordinary contention trials directly establishes whether it executed. No filesystem refusal or ownership-error record was observed in those trials; this is finite race-sample evidence, not proof that the failure is impossible.
ordinaryQa.ordinaryOnly: Maintained ownership tests and shipped launcher suite only. No new fault injection, instrumentation or diagnostic/race harness was run for current-source QA.

run1: Launcher subtest 1: fourth serialized cold-start click reached the fixed 30-second child timeout; first failure 2026-11-20T08:31:35.904Z.
Launcher subtests 5 and 6: long taskbar-relaunch command refusal.
Launcher subtest 10: fixed 30-second click timeout before its ownership assertions.
Launcher parent: fixed 240-second timeout; subtest 12 cancelled by TAP.
Directory-symlink alias subtest: creation returned EPERM; alias parent failed.
run2: Launcher subtests 5 and 6: same relaunch-command refusal, plus launcher parent failure.
Directory symlink: same creation EPERM, plus alias parent failure.
nativeFailures.pathLimit: Fixture commands are 273-290 characters against the launcher's below-260 bound, with no short-name fallback at this location. A CI-style-path calculation yields 208; that is a calculation, not a hosted test result.
nativeFailures.symlinkLimit: Native creation returned EPERM. Host privilege and Developer Mode settings were not examined; a specific cause is not established.
nativeFailures.timingLimit: Run-1 timing failures coincided with heavy host load and passed in run 2. Load samples do not establish individual causal attribution.
